definitions.explanation: Describes something happening very shortly after another event. Emphasizes the small time gap between two events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直後|ちょくご}に⟦{走|はし}らないで→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't run right after eating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直後|ちょくご}に⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The police arrived immediately after the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直後|ちょくご}に、SNS⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{反響|はんきょう}→反響：09126_hankyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Immediately after the announcement, there was a big reaction on social media.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧ is a noun meaning "immediately after" and is commonly followed by the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. It can also modify nouns directly: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧ (the confusion right after the earthquake).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{直前|ちょくぜん}→直前：13651_chokuzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (immediately before) is the opposite
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (after) is more casual and does not emphasize immediacy

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直後|ちょくご}に (right after ~)
- ⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧ (right after the start)
- ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧ (immediately upon arrival)
